model.unitarity: lossless passive 2x2 couplers, coherent complex amplitude model
model.energy_conservation: pre-loss output power = input power within floating point tolerance

browser.environment: Chromium headless, local HTML loaded via set_content

limitations: Training target is generated from same programmable network family, so this verifies an in-family software fitting task only.
Unseen samples use new input vectors but share target transform and generator family.
Output intensities do not uniquely identify all complex phase parameters.
Loss is applied as uniform scalar attenuation only after unitary network.
This is not a fabricated silicon photonic device or a general neuromorphic processor.
User-visible RGB color swatches denote spatial inputs, not independent optical wavelengths.
next: PHOTON-16 v0.5: heldout out-of-family mesh targets, drift-aware training, finite-difference calibration losses.
